In statistical contexts, most estimands are parameters of probabilistic
models, or functions of model parameters.

::: callout-note
#### Notation for estimands

Model parameters and other estimands are often symbolized using
lower-case Greek letters.
The [notation choices page](https://morrison-lab.github.io/macros/notation-choices.html#sec-estimand-estimator-symbols)
gives our convention and the alternatives.
:::
